eq6_display_erratum.as_printed_v1: ssat(n, C_5) <= ceil(11/8 (n-1)) for all n >= 5.   (arXiv:1103.0067v1, Section 4, Eq. (6); direction: upper bound on ssat; range: 'for all n >= 5'; ceiling)
eq6_display_erratum.correction: Eq. (6) is FALSIFIED at n = 6 and unsupported on the whole class n = 8t+6. Corrected display consistent with the paper's own construction: ssat(n,C5) <= ceil(11(n-1)/8) for n not congruent 6 mod 8, and ssat(n,C5) <= 11t+8 = ceil(11(n-1)/8)+1 for n = 8t+6 (t>=0).

evidence.n6_falsified: Exhaustive enumeration (complete): no C5-semisaturated graph on 6 vertices with 7 edges exists (all 6435 seven-edge graphs checked; two independent definitions - literal C5-copy-count and 4-path - agree on 12183 graphs including all n=5 graphs and all n=6 graphs with m<=6). ssat(6) = 8 exactly, witnessed by {01,02,03,04,05,12,13,24}. ceil(11*5/8) = 7 < 8. Independently reproduces r343's finding.
evidence.n8_exact: ssat(8) = 10 exactly (new exact value, this lane): no semisaturated graph on 8 vertices with <= 9 edges (complete enumeration of all 11,199,045 graph edge-sets with m in {7,8,9}, pruned by min-degree and Lemma 7.1 filters, then 4-path check and connectivity); witness = the paper's own pendant-dropped construction with 10 edges. ceil(11*7/8) = 10: Eq. (6) HOLDS at n=8.
evidence.exact_values: ssat(5)=6, ssat(6)=8, ssat(7)=9, ssat(8)=10 (5,6,7 confirm r343; 8 is new). All verified under the literal C5-copy-count definition.
evidence.construction_gap: The paper's own construction (decoded from the v1 figure, ar5iv asset es1_2.png, and confirmed against OWR Fig.1): each 8-vertex block is the tree {1-2,3-4,5-6,7-8,1-3,3-5,5-7} (spine 2-1-3-5-7-8, leaves 4,6) plus spokes y-1,y-3,y-5,y-7; 11 edges per block, n=1+8t; joining j triangles to y adds 2j vertices and 3j edges; deleting a leaf gives even n. Per class: 8t+1->11t, 8t+3->11t+3, 8t+5->11t+6, 8t+7->11t+9, 8t->11t-1, 8t+2->11t+2, 8t+4->11t+5, 8t+6->11t+8. All nine instances verified C5-semisaturated (n=9,10,11,12,13,14,15,17; literal definition for n<=13). Only the 8t+6 class exceeds the displayed (6): 11t+8 > ceil(11(8t+5)/8) = 11t+7.

eq6_display_erratum.impact_on_conjecture: NONE. A finite-n violation of a displayed upper bound cannot refute an asymptotic claim, and both candidate corrections (11t+7 and 11t+8 for n=8t+6) lie within O(1) of 11n/8. The deficit e - 11n/8 observed so far: -7/8 (n=5), -1/4 (n=6), -5/8 (n=7), -1 (n=8), -11/8 (FK construction, n=8t+1). The conjecture is consistent with all data.

corrected_source_claim.definition_verified: G is C5-semisaturated iff for every non-edge uv, G+uv has strictly more C5 subgraph-copies than G. Provably equivalent to: every non-adjacent pair is joined by a path of length 4 with three distinct internal vertices (any new C5 must contain the new edge). Both implementations checked for agreement on 12183 graphs; r343 witnesses re-verified under the literal count definition.

full_scope_mechanism.status: PARKED with precise missing universal lemma
reduction: Lemma 7.1 (Furedi-Kim, verified): pendant (deg-1) vertices have distinct neighbors of degree >= 3, so x <= n/2 where x = number of pendant vertices; and deleting a pendant vertex preserves C5-semisaturation.
Hence for the 2-core G0 (delete pendant vertices; still C5-semisaturated, min degree >= 2, N = n - x vertices): e(G) = x + e(G0).

Sufficient target lemma (THE MISSING UNIVERSAL LEMMA): e(G0) >= (11N + 3x)/8 - C for an ABSOLUTE constant C. Combined with x <= n/2 this gives e(G) >= 11n/8 - C, proving the conjecture's lower bound; the FK construction shows C >= 11/8, so the lemma, if true with C = 11/8, is tight (ssat = 11n/8 - 11/8 along n = 8t+1).

This is a GLOBAL constant on the whole core; it is NOT a sum of per-block errors, so the r344 objection (per-block constants need not sum to O(1) when endblocks are unbounded) does not apply to this formulation.
naive_plans_refuted: NAIVE CORE LEMMA (core alone >= 7N/4 - C) IS FALSE: the friendship graph F_t (t triangles sharing one vertex) has min degree 2, is C5-semisaturated (verified t=1..6), and e(F_t) = 3t on N = 2t+1 vertices gives e - 7N/4 = -t/2 - 7/4 -> -infinity.

NAIVE LEAF-BLOCK DENSITY PLAN (r343): per-endblock inequalities cannot sum to an absolute constant when the number of endblocks grows; and pendants cannot simply be attached to a sparse core: attaching pendants to the center of F_t DESTROYS semisaturation (no 4-path from a pendant to an outer vertex; verified t=2..5, first failing pair is pendant-to-outer). The pendant-attachment structure is where the real content lies.
full_scope_mechanism.why_parked: Verifying the coupled lemma requires new structural understanding of how pendant 4-path witnesses constrain the core around deg>=3 attachment vertices; no concrete proof mechanism for the absolute constant survived bounded inspection, and the gate forbids a deep discharging investment without a surviving full-scope mechanism. The lemma is finite-checkable in small cases (n<=8 exhaustive minima of the coupled deficit: -7/8, -1/4, -5/8, -1; FK construction: -11/8), which is the recommended next bounded step (n=9,10 exact values were NOT run, per the do-not-expand gate before source resolution; now permissible but a root decision).
full_scope_mechanism.no_universal_constant_claim_from_finite_: No O(1) claim is made from finite trends; the deficit minima above are data, not theorems.
